element.headline: Chief Information Officer at Altura Centers for Health
element.about:
An innovative and results-driven Information Technology leader and SW application engineer with extensive experience in software/application development, systems engineering/analysis, strategic planning, best practices, troubleshooting, research and development, product innovation, and end-user support.  Proven to accomplish quality performance and elevate customer experience.  Successfully defines and releases custom products with strong first pass execution, pushing delivery of quality to highest standards.  Possesses a track record of accomplishment in contributing to the capabilities and growth of an organization.

•	Pre- and Post-Sales Support/Customer Training
•	Large-Scale Design/Deployment/Troubleshooting
•	Analytical Planning/Strategic Workflow Planning
•	Creating Processes/Standards/Best Practices
•	Company Presenter/World Stage Conferences

currentPosition.description:
Responsible for planning, designing and implementation of software and information system infrastructure to meet the clinic's organizational objectives.

This includes:
- Oversee the electronic information Health Record (EHR) system.
- Develop and implement patient and employee service platform.
- Design, implement and maintain the current and future network infrastructure.
- Propose hardware/software solutions to accomplish the clinic's objectives.

Worked with key industry audio vendors to implement custom framework for the design.  Achieved company 2005 application specific processor customer excellence award for securing major audio customer, bringing in $10,000,000 LTR.  Engaged with Home Audio customers to ensure design wins of many Japanese vendors, including framework customization and various debugging and training.  Collaborated with hardware design team to ensure key software RTOS components flawless for inclusion into device’s ROM.  

•	Integrated RTOS releases into audio & video framework to ensure quality of components before release to market.
•	Worked with network developer’s kit to illustrate IP multicasting capabilities on DSP.  
•	Conducted several conference presentations on device and system software capabilities.

Provided second line customer support for target content for DSPs.  Reproduced and reported bugs to software development team.  Assisted kernel development team with testing and validation.

Applications Analyst IPA Specialty II for NextGen EHR software. Troubleshooting, program configuration, template modifications, education, upgrade implementation. Provide networking and technical support for external provider offices. Extensive use of Remote Desktop and Terminal Servers.

Front desk receptionist during office hours, greeted clients, answered phones, and performed clerical duties as needed.
